_comment: Tolerance profiles for running open-fdd in the G36 cross-check. `openfdd_defaults` passes no override: each open-fdd engine runs at its own registry defaults. `g36` sets the G36 Table 5.16.14.7 initial tolerances CAMBER's g36_afdd uses by default (camber.fdd_g36.G36Thresholds: eps SAT 2, RAT 2, MAT 5, OAT 5, CCET 5, CCLT 2, HCET 5, HCLT 2 degF; supply-fan heat 2 degF; duct static 0.1 inH2O; fan speed 0.05; airflow 0.30; dT_min 10 degF; dOS_max 7). Tolerances only: delays, confirm windows and the 'valve fully open' / damper-position thresholds stay at each engine's defaults and are reported as such. Overrides go through each engine's supported mechanism: the pandas engine's `params` argument of open_fdd.rules.run_rule, and the SQL engine's rule_tuning/defaults.yaml (read by fdd_cli run-rules from the directory next to --rules-dir). SQL notes: several SQL rules use one tolerance placeholder for every sensor in the equation (FC5, FC10 read EPS_MAT; FC12 reads MIX_TOL). Their equations add the two sensor tolerances (or take the root-sum-square of two equal ones), so the value below reproduces the G36 margin exactly: FC5/FC12 SAT 2 + MAT 5 = 2 x 3.5; FC10 sqrt(5^2 + 5^2) = sqrt(2 x 5^2). `sql_not_expressible` lists the FCs whose G36 tolerance the tuning file cannot reach in the pinned SQL source (static reading of crates/fdd_rules/src/params.rs at the pinned commit; the harness's SQL probe confirms or refutes it when the engine runs).

openfdd_defaults.description: open-fdd at its own registry defaults (no override)

g36.description: open-fdd at the G36 Table 5.16.14.7 tolerances CAMBER uses

sql_not_expressible.FC7: the rule reads EPS_SAT, which is always set from SUPPLY_TOL (default 1.15); FC7 declares no supply_tol, so eps_sat cannot be raised to 2
sql_not_expressible.FC9: the rule reads EPS_MAT for both OAT and SAT but declares no eps_mat, so it stays at the 1.15 global default (mix_tol cannot reach it)
sql_not_expressible.FC14: the rule reads EPS_MAT for both coil temperatures but declares no eps_mat (1.15 global default)
